anomalies.name: VRAM Exhaustion (OOM)
anomalies.signature: model process killed; seat status=down reason=oom in fleet-heartbeat.json
anomalies.threshold: VRAM usage >95% on target GPU; nvidia-smi OOM kill in dmesg

anomalies.name: Cycle Duration Breach
anomalies.signature: cycle elapsed > SLA; auto-diagnostic captures stack+model+passes

anomalies.name: Mirror Sync Revert (Pin Clobber)
anomalies.signature: file content reverts to pre-edit state after mirror sync; md5 mismatch
anomalies.threshold: md5 mismatch between local edit and post-sync state; >1 revert in 10min window

anomalies.name: Model Load Failure
anomalies.signature: model fails to load on seat (timeout, missing file, VRAM insufficient)
anomalies.threshold: load attempt >30s without ready signal; reason field in model-load.jsonl
anomalies.recovery_script: retry with quant downgrade; after 3 fails: mark degraded + route to backup

anomalies.name: Seat Unreachable (Full Offline)
anomalies.signature: seat probe returns connection refused/timeout; all model endpoints dead
anomalies.threshold: 3 consecutive probes fail (>90s); seat absent from fleet-heartbeat.json or status=unreachable
anomalies.frequency: 5 seats unreachable at last run start (Builder, Forge, Orchestrator, Pixel, Scribe)
anomalies.recovery_script: Mechanic diagnostics; WinRM chain for remote hosts; elev.py for local

heartbeat_integration.note: Mechanic's heartbeat consolidation goal (#2) will consume this file
